author: Theophilus of Antioch
note: The earliest surviving use of the word 'Trinity' (Greek trias) for the Godhead — c. AD 180, well before the creeds fixed the vocabulary. Key witness for the Trinity intro's 'before the creeds' point. Filed under Trinity (not deity) so it does not inflate the deity-of-Christ pre-Nicaea stat. Verified verbatim against source_url (apologia-citations, web, 2026-08-24).
text: In like manner also the three days which were before the luminaries, are types of the Trinity, of God, and His Word, and His wisdom.
